title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, my hall monitor friends!
Let us give next week's dress code checks our utmost effort!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We can right everyone's uniform wrongs and help create a virtuous environment here at Kamiyama High!

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitors
rows.Line:
Agreed!
Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem.
That is all from future star and protector of our school environment, Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I thank you all for joining me during your valuable lunch break.
Please, everyone, go enjoy your lunches.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitors
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Yes, that was a fine speech, if I do say so myself. It appears everyone is more motivated to uphold the rules now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Having something to look forward to truly does put you in good shape! Today should be a good day!)

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line:
You seem to be in a cheery mood, Tenma.
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not yet, but it's going to!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You see, today is the day this future star was born! Tsukasa Tenma's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line: Whoa! It's your birthday?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. And for a while now, my dearest sister has been enthusiastically planning my celebration.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, my heart has been dancing with anticipation all morning.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line: It sounds like she cares for you very much. That should be something to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor B
rows.Line: And hey, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! Thank you!
I couldn't be happier to be receiving such warm wishes from my hall monitor colleagues.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I would love to have a lively chat about the occasion, but shouldn't you all be heading off to lunch before the break ends?

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Thanks again, Tenma. We'll be off to lunch!

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitors
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now then, I should be getting to lunch myself.
The weather's nice today. Perhaps I should go outside to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Perfect, Tenma, you're here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...? Ah, Shiraishi.
What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look! Over there, don't you see it?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Over there...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That ridiculously out-of-place object on the ground...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that one of Rui's robots?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Sure is weird how it's just sitting there, isn't it? Pretty mysterious...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't imagine Rui being so neglectful of a tool he uses in shows...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But that's neither here nor there.
I appreciate you letting me know, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Of course...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll get it off the ground and bring it to...
Hm? It's moving?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hey! Wait! Where are you going?!
More importantly, don't run in the corridor!
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... Where did it go?
I saw it on its way to the roof...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

Happy birthday.
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. So... Can we call this surprise a huge success?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I told you.
There was no chance Tsukasa wouldn't fall for this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nuh-uh, this was all because I brought him right here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm impressed you can be proud of that awkward acting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha, sorry, Tsukasa!
This has all been our birthday surprise!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We apologize for startling you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I never imagined...
To think you all prepared this surprise just for me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh, I couldn't be happier to be blessed with such wonderful friends! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You're always so overdramatic.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, let's eat instead of just standing around talking. How's about we have a birthday luncheon?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sounds great! Let's grab our lunches and gather back here!
You too, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I'll bring it right away!
That said, nobody get any ideas about running in the corridor, understood?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
You were planning my surprise that far in advance?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, at Aoyagi's request.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. I was asking around a bit... I wondered what sort of gift would befit you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And we figured, if we wanna celebrate, we should put a surprise together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't remember ever agreeing to it, but at some point that was just the way things were going...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that so...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, don't you think you should hand over his present right about now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, of course.
Thank you all again for helping taste test.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Taste test...? What did you make, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here. I made these...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! These are cupcakes, if my eyes don't deceive me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I recall you enjoyed them last time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's rather dull of me to make the same thing again, but I couldn't see any other treats coming out well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sure you would've done just fine! And let me just say, these look even better than the ones you made before!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They look quite extravagant, and I can tell you put a lot into them. They all look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's thanks to everyone's advice.
I particularly appreciated getting detailed input from Akito with regards to the flavor.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was nothing. You asked what I thought, so I told you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You mean to say everyone put a lot of thought and care into these cupcakes...
There are plenty to go around, so let's have them together in celebration!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't wait to have some of Toya's homemade treats♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
Would you open your gift from me once we're finished eating?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so you brought something as well, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I brought a new piece of stage equipment.
I hope you'll like it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: New...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Stage equipment...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait a second. I didn't hear anything about that gift.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It had better not be one of your contraptions that explodes!
An explosion is the last thing I need on my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I felt that something extravagant and memorable would be fitting for the occasion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So it is going to explode!!!

rows.Speaker: An, Toya & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Hehe.
